about_the_game:
One day a lonely ostrich named Tark is whisked away from his peaceful valley home by a whirling tornado and flung into a dream-like realm where he encounters the GRAVITY WHIP. Using its incredible power to alter the direction of gravity, Tark is on a quest to unravel his way out of the Maze of Dreams and find a way back home. But will he be able to get past the dark forces hidden deep within? Find out in Gravity Whipped - an exciting 2.5D Puzzle Platformer by Packet Gaming Studios.

Gravity Whipped - how far will you go?

Chance roulette and upgrade system:

  • Every 40 coins you collect you will get a chance to roll a roulette to win one of 4 different powerups:

    • SPEED - Increases player's speed

    • HEALTH - Increases player's max health

    • MAGNET - Attracts coins to player when in range

    • AWARENESS - Exposes hidden clues and secret areas when in range

-Each powerup has 3 levels of upgrade that can be used to make them even more powerful.

-Up to 2 powerups can be held at once, with the option to replace them with any new powerups won by roulette.

-Different powerup combinations provide variety to the already solid gameplay and create unique experiences with each play through.

Features:

  • 196 rooms spread out across 36 levels and other secret areas - with a variety of 2.5D linear, and 3D open ended formats.

  • Gravity based puzzles are highly open-ended and may have numerous ways to be completed.

  • A collectathon paradise! Over 3355 collectibles to snatch. Items will reset at the beginning of each level.

  • 40 coin roulette chances to win one of 4 different powerups, each with 3 upgrade levels. Up to 2 can be held simultaneously.

  • Speed runners welcome! Complete time challenges and set a best record for each standard level.

  • Rebindable controls - supports standard game controllers, keyboard and mouse.

  • 3 difficulty settings, an epic boss battle and multiple endings.

  • Unlockable levels, bonus content and many other hidden secrets.

  • Supports English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Korean, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.

short_description: Use the incredible power of the Gravity Whip to alter the direction of gravity and whip your way through the mysterious Maze of Dreams in this exciting 2.5D Puzzle Platformer. Jump over spike pits and collect coins and gems to upgrade your character and unlock secret levels. How far will you go?
